audits.method: Serial alternating-order complete audits, including maps. Both policies are warmed once. Kernel load, input loading, comparison and hashing are outside each audit timer. Only elapsed time is excluded from exact output equality.

browserAudits.method: Same complete audit, including maps. Four rounds rotate policy order after one warmup for each policy and input. Loading, warmups and exact comparisons are outside audit timers. current selects the measured backend; cachedJavaScript and forcedWasm isolate backend costs with the same outline reuse.

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

weighted.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

diagnostics.note: Only WebKit returned the worker profiling counters. Separate profiled runs include instrumentation overhead and may perform different numbers of deadline-dependent iterations.

limitations: Complete-audit equivalence excludes only elapsed time; the retained hashes identify every compared report and map.
Saved fitted curves are validator inputs only. Fresh-fit benchmarks start from photographs or generated masks.
The whole-solve batches are separate runs, not alternating comparisons. Speed depends on runtime and hardware, and fitting remains deadline-dependent.
The guarded discrete paper model does not certify tear resistance or physical assembly.
